messages.subject: Exogen variables in path analysis
parts:
Dear All,

I have a path analysis with two exogen dummy variables, gender (coded as 1 and 2) and season (coded as 1 and 2). I've built the model, but by default, these two variables are covariated. How can I remove that path from my model? Unfortunately I didn't find any R script related to this issue. 

Thank you very much!

Attila

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Exogen variables in path analysis
parts:
lat.mod1 <- '# latent variables
state =~ ug + b + h + smi
# regressions
state ~ sex + seas
# residual covariances
ug ~~ b + h
b ~~ h

# exogenous variables
sex ~~ 0*seas
'
fit.lat.mod1 <- sem(lat.mod1, data=bac, fixed.x=FALSE)

should do it. Usually, we do not model/include the exogenous part of the
model. If you do, you need the 'fixed.x=FALSE' flag.

But why would you want to constrain a covariance between exogenous
variables to be zero? The fit will be worse (unless the covariance is
about zero in the sample).

Yves.
